gate.source_note: Separate complete-profile source-validation fold (%8==3), previously reporting-only in aggregate. Not new patients; not Kenyan clinical validation.

source_splits.policy: V3 retained unchanged. Original signature-even tuning selects thresholds. Previously reporting-only signature%4==1 source profiles validate selected risk bounds; signature%4==3 profiles report validation. Test excludes every source training/validation signature. Tuning/calibration/reporting-validation use first label-blind row per complete-198-feature signature. The 53,387 retained test records include one without supported positive evidence; the same 53,386 eligible cases as prior V3 are used for disease-ranking metrics.
